intro: The Steak + Harissa Bowl from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) combines tender grilled steak with bold Mediterranean flavors and spicy harissa for a protein-packed meal. This expertly crafted bowl features black lentils, fire-roasted corn, and pickled onions, all brought together with Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. At 620 calories with 37g of protein, it delivers satisfying nutrition with authentic taste.
priceCalories: Priced between $15.45 and $16.55, the Steak + Harissa Bowl offers 620 calories per serving. With a robust macronutrient profile of 37g protein, 39g carbs, and 35g fat, this bowl provides balanced nutrition for an active lifestyle. The price reflects premium grilled steak and quality ingredients found throughout the [full CAVA menu](/), making it a worthwhile investment.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this bowl apart is the perfect marriage of tender grilled steak with fiery harissa seasoning and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. The combination of protein-rich black lentils with fire-roasted corn creates incredible texture, while pickled onions add tangy brightness. This curated bowl showcases CAVA's expertise in balancing bold Mediterranean spices with fresh, wholesome ingredients for maximum flavor impact.
nutritionFacts: With 620 calories, the Steak + Harissa Bowl delivers substantial nutrition without excess. The 37g of protein supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while 39g of carbohydrates provide sustained energy. The 35g of fat comes from quality sources including the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. This balanced macronutrient profile makes it suitable for various dietary goals.
whatsInside: This bowl features premium grilled steak as the star protein, complemented by fiber-rich black lentils from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases). Harissa seasoning and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette provide signature heat, while tomato and onion add freshness. Fire-roasted corn contributes sweetness and texture, with pickled onions delivering a tangy finish that cuts through the richness beautifully.
tasteLike: Expect bold, spicy flavors with the first bite as harissa heat meets tender, savory grilled steak. The black lentils provide earthy depth, while fire-roasted corn adds subtle sweetness. Pickled onions cut through with bright acidity, and the Hot Harissa Vinaigrette ties everything together with smoky, spicy notes. The result is a complex, satisfying taste experience with Mediterranean flair.
customize: Personalize your Steak + Harissa Bowl using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to adjust ingredients and track macros. Add extra protein from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains), include creamy dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads), or swap in different vegetables from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). Request dressing on the side to control spice level and calories.
pairsWell: This bowl pairs excellently with cooling options from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) like tzatziki or hummus to balance the harissa heat. A crisp drink from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) complements the spicy flavors perfectly. For dessert, something light helps finish the meal. The bold spices also work well alongside the Chicken + Rice Bowl for sharing.
healthyChoice: At 620 calories with 37g of high-quality protein, this bowl supports fitness and wellness goals effectively. The black lentils provide fiber and plant-based protein, while grilled steak offers complete amino acids. Fire-roasted vegetables add vitamins and antioxidants. For those with dietary restrictions, check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) and [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for modifications.
howToOrder: Order the Steak + Harissa Bowl at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it by name from the curated bowls section. It comes pre-configured with all ingredients, but you can request modifications at no extra charge. For online ordering, select it from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). The bowl typically takes 5-7 minutes to prepare fresh.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Chicken + Rice Bowl at 700 calories ($12.85-$13.45), this offers more protein per calorie with bolder spice. The Harissa Avocado Bowl provides 830 calories ($13.95-$14.95) with more fat, while the Greek Salad Bowl offers 580 calories ($12.85-$13.45) as a lighter option. The Falafel Crunch Bowl has 860 calories ($13.45-$14.45) for a vegetarian alternative.
whoShouldTry: This bowl is perfect for spice lovers who appreciate bold harissa flavors and Mediterranean cuisine. Fitness enthusiasts benefit from the high protein content and balanced macros. Those seeking a filling, nutritious lunch or dinner will appreciate the generous portions. However, those sensitive to spicy foods may want to request less harissa or choose milder options instead.
worthTrying: The Steak + Harissa Bowl absolutely delivers on taste, nutrition, and value at $15.45-$16.55. The combination of premium grilled steak, fiber-rich lentils, and bold harissa creates an unforgettable flavor experience. With 620 well-balanced calories and 37g of protein, it satisfies both your taste buds and nutritional needs. This curated bowl exemplifies CAVA's commitment to quality Mediterranean cuisine.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Steak + Harissa Bowl?
faqs.a: The Steak + Harissa Bowl contains 620 calories with 37g of protein, 39g of carbohydrates, and 35g of fat. This balanced macronutrient profile makes it suitable for various dietary goals while providing satisfying nutrition and bold Mediterranean flavors in every bite.

faqs.q: How much does the Steak + Harissa Bowl cost?
faqs.a: The Steak + Harissa Bowl is priced between $15.45 and $16.55 depending on your location. This price reflects the premium grilled steak, quality ingredients, and expertly curated combination of Mediterranean flavors that make this bowl a customer favorite at CAVA restaurants.

faqs.q: Is the Steak + Harissa Bowl spicy?
faqs.a: Yes, this bowl features significant heat from both harissa seasoning and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. The spice level is moderate to high, perfect for those who enjoy bold flavors. You can request less harissa or dressing on the side to control the heat level.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Steak + Harissa Bowl?
faqs.a: Absolutely! You can modify any ingredient in the Steak + Harissa Bowl at no extra charge. Add or remove toppings, swap the base, choose different dressings, or include extra protein. Use the CAVA Nutrition Calculator to preview nutritional changes before ordering.

faqs.q: Is the Steak + Harissa Bowl gluten-free?
faqs.a: The Steak + Harissa Bowl can be made gluten-free with careful ingredient selection. The grilled steak, black lentils, and most vegetables are naturally gluten-free. Check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu and inform staff of your dietary needs to ensure proper preparation and avoid cross-contamination.
